name: SKINETIC AI+ professional AI skin diagnostic system
shortDescription: Objective skin assessment, visual consultations, documented results. 15 MP camera, 8 imaging modes, AI-based analysis, before-after comparison - with scalp and face microscope included.
description:
SKINETIC AI+ is a professional, AI-supported skin analysis system for beauty salons, skin therapists and aesthetic providers. It uses high-resolution digital imaging, multiple specialised lighting modes and AI-based image analysis to give a more detailed and more consistent picture of the client's current skin condition.

The system goes beyond the skin surface: the different light sources and analysis modes also support the examination of irregularities that are less visible under normal light. Results are presented in a clear, visual report, so during the consultation you can not only explain but actually show your client which areas deserve more attention.

SKINETIC AI+ is a non-invasive skin assessment system for cosmetic and aesthetic purposes: the AI evaluation supports the professional's work - it does not replace it and is not intended to diagnose medical conditions.

features.title: Multiple light sources - more information
features.description:
The system uses 8 imaging modes, each revealing different skin characteristics: natural light, polarised light, cross-polarised light, UV light, Wood's light, red zone, brown zone and moisture analysis.

Natural light shows the skin's true appearance, pores and fine lines; polarised light reduces surface reflection to reveal redness, dilated capillaries and pigmentation irregularities; UV illumination makes features visible that are hard to see under normal light.
features.highlight: Evaluating the imaging modes together can provide far more information than visual inspection alone.

features.title: AI-based analysis and visual reports
features.description:
After capturing the images, the AI identifies defined facial regions and evaluates each skin parameter: texture, hydration, pores, sebum distribution, pigmentation, wrinkles, redness, acne-related changes and signs of skin ageing.

Results appear in numeric and visual form - scores, percentages, graphs and problem maps - and the system also estimates the skin's age compared to the client's calendar age. Your client sees with their own eyes exactly what you are talking about.
features.highlight: The client doesn't just hear which areas need attention - they see it.

features.title: Before-after comparison and follow-up
features.description:
It is hard to judge the results of a treatment programme from memory or ordinary photos. With SKINETIC AI+, previous examinations can be retrieved and compared with new results: changes in texture, pigmentation, pores, fine lines and sebum distribution can all be tracked.

This makes the system valuable not only at the first consultation but also for monitoring longer treatment programmes and regular follow-up checks.
features.highlight: Documented change is the best confirmation for the client - and the best argument for continuing the programme.

features.title: Client database and standardised imaging
features.description:
Diagnostic images and results are stored in client profiles: previous examinations, reports and follow-ups are tracked in one place, and reports can be exported and shared as PDF.

Reliable before-after comparison requires images taken under similar conditions. SKINETIC AI+ supports this with a fixed camera position, built-in lighting, a light-shielded examination space, chin and forehead rests, and a defined face-to-camera distance.
features.highlight: The enclosed, light-shielded design reduces the effect of ambient light, making measurements repeatable.

features.title: The "+" in the name: scalp and face microscope
features.description:
The SKINETIC AI+ package includes a handheld scalp and face microscope for close-up examination of selected areas of the scalp and face - a perfect complement to the full-face AI analysis, for example in scalp diagnostic services.

The software is also available with a Hungarian-language interface, edited with the involvement of a cosmetologist.
features.highlight: Close-up scalp and face examination included in the package.

faq.question: Who is SKINETIC AI+ recommended for?
faq.answer: Beauty salons, professional cosmetologists, skin therapists, aesthetic centres, medical-aesthetic practices and studios offering device-based treatments - especially those who want to offer detailed skin assessment, treatment planning and regular follow-up alongside their treatments.

faq.question: What does the system examine?
faq.answer: It supports the analysis of multiple skin parameters at once: texture, hydration, pores, sebum production and distribution, pigmentation, UV-related changes, fine and deeper wrinkles, redness, acne- and comedone-related changes, and general signs of skin ageing. The parameters are evaluated together for a comprehensive picture.

faq.question: Does it replace a medical diagnosis?
faq.answer: No. SKINETIC AI+ is a non-invasive skin assessment system for cosmetic and aesthetic purposes. The AI evaluation supports the professional's work but does not replace it, and it is not intended to diagnose medical conditions. Results must always be interpreted by the treating professional.

faq.question: How does it support consultations and sales?
faq.answer: The client receives a clear visual report with scores, graphs and problem maps, so they can see for themselves which areas need attention and why a given treatment plan is recommended. Before-after comparison visually confirms the results of treatment programmes.

faq.question: What is included with the device?
faq.answer: The package includes the scalp and face microscope, the 15.6-inch touchscreen tablet, operator training with certificate and a 2-year full warranty. Reports can be exported as PDF and data is stored in the cloud.

faq.question: Can I see the device before purchasing?
faq.answer: Yes! You can view and try SKINETIC AI+ in person at our showroom (Érd, Bajcsy-Zsilinszky út 156., Hungary) by booking an appointment in advance.
